# Active rows only (no cancelled)
cancelled_statuses = {'can','cancel','cancelled','canceled','void','voided','rejected'}
df_active = df[~df['row_kind'].isin(['cancel'])].copy()
df_active = df_active[~df_active['STATUS'].str.lower().isin(cancelled_statuses)].copy()

for col in ['REPORTDATE','ACTSTART','ACTFINISH']:
    df_active[col] = pd.to_datetime(df_active[col], utc=True, errors='coerce')

# ── EDA ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try:
    s = df_active['repair_hours'].dropna()
    result['eda_summary'] = {
        'repair_hours': {
            'mean':   float(s.mean()),
            'std':    float(s.std()),
            'min':    float(s.min()),
            'max':    float(s.max()),
            'median': float(s.median()),
            'count':  int(s.count())
        }
    }
except Exception:
    pass

# ── SEGMENTATION ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try:
    segs = []

    # repair_hours mean by WORKTYPE / STATUS / FAILURECODE
    for seg in ['WORKTYPE', 'STATUS', 'FAILURECODE']:
        grp = df_active.groupby(seg)['repair_hours'].mean().dropna().nlargest(10)
        segs.append({
            'segment_column': seg, 'metric_column': 'repair_hours',
            'aggregation': 'mean', 'label': None,
            'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in grp.items()]
        })

    # WO count by WORKTYPE / STATUS / FAILURECODE
    for seg in ['WORKTYPE', 'STATUS', 'FAILURECODE']:
        grp = df_active.groupby(seg)['WONUM'].nunique().nlargest(10)
        segs.append({
            'segment_column': seg, 'metric_column': 'WONUM',
            'aggregation': 'count', 'label': None,
            'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': float(v)} for k, v in grp.items()]
        })

    # PM share
    pm_types = {'pm','preventive','preventive maintenance','planned','planned maintenance',
                'pdm','predictive','predictive maintenance','condition based','cbm',
                'inspection','routine','calibration'}
    total_wos = df_active['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_wos    = df_active[df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().isin(pm_types)]['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_share  = round(pm_wos / total_wos, 4) if total_wos else 0.0
    segs.append({
        'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE', 'metric_column': 'WONUM',
        'aggregation': 'ratio', 'label': 'pm_share',
        'results': [{'name': 'pm',     'value': pm_share},
                    {'name': 'non_pm', 'value': round(1 - pm_share, 4)}]
    })

    # MTTR by FAILURECODE (CM/EM only, repair_hours >= 0)
    cm_types = {'cm','em','corrective','corrective maintenance','emergency',
                'emergency maintenance','emergency repair','breakdown',
                'breakdown maintenance','breakdown repair','reactive',
                'reactive maintenance','unplanned','unplanned maintenance',
                'unplanned breakdown','repair','fault','failure'}
    df_cm = df_active[
        df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().isin(cm_types) &
        df_active['repair_hours'].notna() &
        (df_active['repair_hours'] >= 0)
    ]
    if len(df_cm) > 0:
        mttr_fc = (
            df_cm.groupby('FAILURECODE')
            .apply(lambda x: x['repair_hours'].sum() / x['WONUM'].nunique())
            .nlargest(10)
        )
        segs.append({
            'segment_column': 'FAILURECODE', 'metric_column': 'repair_hours',
            'aggregation': 'ratio', 'label': 'mttr_hours',
            'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in mttr_fc.items()]
        })

    # WORKTYPE × STATUS joint breakdown (top 10 by WO count)
    joint = (
        df_active.groupby(['WORKTYPE','STATUS'])['WONUM'].nunique()
        .nlargest(10).reset_index()
    )
    segs.append({
        'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE|STATUS', 'metric_column': 'WONUM',
        'aggregation': 'count', 'label': None,
        'results': [{'name': f"{r['WORKTYPE']}|{r['STATUS']}", 'value': float(r['WONUM'])}
                    for _, r in joint.iterrows()]
    })

    result['segments'] = segs
except Exception:
    pass

# ── TRENDS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try:
    trends = []
    df_active['_month'] = df_active['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')

    # MoM repair_hours mean overall
    monthly = df_active.groupby('_month')['repair_hours'].mean().sort_index()
    if len(monthly) >= 2:
        prev, last = float(monthly.iloc[-2]), float(monthly.iloc[-1])
        pct = round((last - prev) / prev * 100, 4) if prev != 0 else 0.0
        trends.append({'column': 'repair_hours', 'period': 'MoM',
                       'direction': 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat'),
                       'pct_change': pct, 'segment': None})

    # MoM WO volume (count) overall
    monthly_cnt = df_active.groupby('_month')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_index()
    if len(monthly_cnt) >= 2:
        prev, last = float(monthly_cnt.iloc[-2]), float(monthly_cnt.iloc[-1])
        pct = round((last - prev) / prev * 100, 4) if prev != 0 else 0.0
        trends.append({'column': 'WONUM', 'period': 'MoM',
                       'direction': 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat'),
                       'pct_change': pct, 'segment': None})

    # MoM repair_hours mean per WORKTYPE
    for wt, grp in df_active.groupby('WORKTYPE'):
        m = grp.groupby('_month')['repair_hours'].mean().sort_index()
        if len(m) >= 2:
            prev, last = float(m.iloc[-2]), float(m.iloc[-1])
            pct = round((last - prev) / prev * 100, 4) if prev != 0 else 0.0
            trends.append({'column': 'repair_hours', 'period': 'MoM',
                           'direction': 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat'),
                           'pct_change': pct, 'segment': str(wt)})

    result['trends'] = trends
except Exception:
    pass

# ── ANOMALIES ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try:
    anomalies = []
    cap = 25
    s = df_active['repair_hours'].dropna()

    if len(s) >= 5:
        skew = float(s.skew())
        shift = max(0.0, -float(s.min()))
        if abs(skew) > 2:
            s_t = np.log1p(s + shift)
        else:
            s_t = s.copy()

        q1, q3 = float(s_t.quantile(0.25)), float(s_t.quantile(0.75))
        iqr = q3 - q1
        lo_t, hi_t = q1 - 3 * iqr, q3 + 3 * iqr
        flagged = s_t[(s_t < lo_t) | (s_t > hi_t)]

        if len(flagged) / len(s_t) > 0.05:
            anomalies.append({
                'column': 'repair_hours', 'row_index': None, 'value': None,
                'expected_range': 'heavy-tailed distribution', 'severity': 'low',
                'explanation': 'repair_hours is heavy-tailed; extreme values are natural, not flagged individually.'
            })
        else:
            if abs(skew) > 2:
                lo_orig = round(float(np.expm1(lo_t) - shift), 4)
                hi_orig = round(float(np.expm1(hi_t) - shift), 4)
            else:
                lo_orig, hi_orig = round(float(lo_t), 4), round(float(hi_t), 4)
            exp_range = f"[{lo_orig}, {hi_orig}]"

            for idx in flagged.index:
                if cap <= 0:
                    break
                raw_val = round(float(s.loc[idx]), 4)
                t_val   = float(s_t.loc[idx])
                if   t_val > q3 + 5 * iqr or t_val < q1 - 5 * iqr: sev = 'critical'
                elif t_val > q3 + 4 * iqr or t_val < q1 - 4 * iqr: sev = 'high'
                else:                                                  sev = 'medium'
                anomalies.append({
                    'column': 'repair_hours', 'row_index': int(idx), 'value': raw_val,
                    'expected_range': exp_range, 'severity': sev,
                    'explanation': f"repair_hours value {raw_val} lies outside expected range {exp_range}."
                })
                cap -= 1

    result['anomalies'] = anomalies
except Exception:
    pass

result['assumptions'] = [
    "Cancelled work orders (row_kind='cancel' or STATUS in cancelled list) excluded from all KPIs.",
    "repair_hours column used as-is; rows with repair_hours < 0 excluded from MTTR.",
    "MTTR computed only for CM/EM work types: total repair_hours / distinct WOs.",
    "PM share = distinct PM WOs / all distinct non-cancelled WOs.",
    "Anomaly detection uses log1p transform when |skew| > 2; columns flagging >5% rows treated as heavy-tailed."
]
assumptions: repair_hours column used as-is; rows with repair_hours < 0 excluded from MTTR.
MTTR computed only for CM/EM work types: total repair_hours / distinct WOs.

            'segment_column': seg, 'metric_column': 'WONUM',
            'aggregation': 'count', 'label': None,
            'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': float(v)} for k, v in grp.items()]
        })

    # PM share
    pm_types = {'pm','preventive','preventive maintenance','planned','planned maintenance',
                'pdm','predictive','predictive maintenance','condition based','cbm',
                'inspection','routine','calibration'}
    total_wos = df_active['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_wos    = df_active[df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().isin(pm_types)]['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_share  = round(pm_wos / total_wos, 4) if total_wos else 0.0
    segs.append({
        'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE', 'metric_column': 'WONUM',
        'aggregation': 'ratio', 'label': 'pm_share',
        'results': [{'name': 'pm',     'value': pm_share},
                    {'name': 'non_pm', 'value': round(1 - pm_share, 4)}]
    })

    # MTTR by FAILURECODE (CM/EM only, repair_hours >= 0)
    cm_types = {'cm','em','corrective','corrective maintenance','emergency',
                'emergency maintenance','emergency repair','breakdown',
                'breakdown maintenance','breakdown repair','reactive',
                'reactive maintenance','unplanned','unplanned maintenance',
                'unplanned breakdown','repair','fault','failure'}
    df_cm = df_active[
        df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().isin(cm_types) &
        df_active['repair_hours'].notna() &
        (df_active['repair_hours'] >= 0)
    ]
    if len(df_cm) > 0:
        mttr_fc = (
            df_cm.groupby('FAILURECODE')
            .apply(lambda x: x['repair_hours'].sum() / x['WONUM'].nunique())
            .nlargest(10)
        )
        segs.append({
            'segment_column': 'FAILURECODE', 'metric_column': 'repair_hours',
            'aggregation': 'ratio', 'label': 'mttr_hours',
            'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in mttr_fc.items()]
        })

    # WORKTYPE × STATUS joint breakdown (top 10 by WO count)
    joint = (
        df_active.groupby(['WORKTYPE','STATUS'])['WONUM'].nunique()
        .nlargest(10).reset_index()
    )
    segs.append({
        'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE|STATUS', 'metric_column': 'WONUM',
        'aggregation': 'count', 'label': None,
        'results': [{'name': f"{r['WORKTYPE']}|{r['STATUS']}", 'value': float(r['WONUM'])}
                    for _, r in joint.iterrows()]
    })

    result['segments'] = segs
except Exception:
    pass

# ── TRENDS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try:
    trends = []
    df_active['_month'] = df_active['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')

    # MoM repair_hours mean overall
    monthly = df_active.groupby('_month')['repair_hours'].mean().sort_index()
    if len(monthly) >= 2:
        prev, last = float(monthly.iloc[-2]), float(monthly.iloc[-1])
        pct = round((last - prev) / prev * 100, 4) if prev != 0 else 0.0
        trends.append({'column': 'repair_hours', 'period': 'MoM',
                       'direction': 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat'),
                       'pct_change': pct, 'segment': None})

    # MoM WO volume (count) overall
    monthly_cnt = df_active.groupby('_month')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_index()
    if len(monthly_cnt) >= 2:
        prev, last = float(monthly_cnt.iloc[-2]), float(monthly_cnt.iloc[-1])
        pct = round((last - prev) / prev * 100, 4) if prev != 0 else 0.0
        trends.append({'column': 'WONUM', 'period': 'MoM',
                       'direction': 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat'),
                       'pct_change': pct, 'segment': None})

    # MoM repair_hours mean per WORKTYPE
    for wt, grp in df_active.groupby('WORKTYPE'):
        m = grp.groupby('_month')['repair_hours'].mean().sort_index()
        if len(m) >= 2:
            prev, last = float(m.iloc[-2]), float(m.iloc[-1])
            pct = round((last - prev) / prev * 100, 4) if prev != 0 else 0.0
            trends.append({'column': 'repair_hours', 'period': 'MoM',
                           'direction': 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat'),
                           'pct_change': pct, 'segment': str(wt)})

    result['trends'] = trends
except Exception:
    pass

# ── ANOMALIES ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try:
    anomalies = []
    cap = 25
    s = df_active['repair_hours'].dropna()

    if len(s) >= 5:
        skew = float(s.skew())
        shift = max(0.0, -float(s.min()))
        if abs(skew) > 2:
            s_t = np.log1p(s + shift)
        else:
            s_t = s.copy()

        q1, q3 = float(s_t.quantile(0.25)), float(s_t.quantile(0.75))
        iqr = q3 - q1
        lo_t, hi_t = q1 - 3 * iqr, q3 + 3 * iqr
        flagged = s_t[(s_t < lo_t) | (s_t > hi_t)]

        if len(flagged) / len(s_t) > 0.05:
            anomalies.append({
                'column': 'repair_hours', 'row_index': None, 'value': None,
                'expected_range': 'heavy-tailed distribution', 'severity': 'low',
                'explanation': 'repair_hours is heavy-tailed; extreme values are natural, not flagged individually.'
            })
        else:
            if abs(skew) > 2:
                lo_orig = round(float(np.expm1(lo_t) - shift), 4)
                hi_orig = round(float(np.expm1(hi_t) - shift), 4)
            else:
                lo_orig, hi_orig = round(float(lo_t), 4), round(float(hi_t), 4)
            exp_range = f"[{lo_orig}, {hi_orig}]"

            for idx in flagged.index:
                if cap <= 0:
                    break
                raw_val = round(float(s.loc[idx]), 4)
                t_val   = float(s_t.loc[idx])
                if   t_val > q3 + 5 * iqr or t_val < q1 - 5 * iqr: sev = 'critical'
                elif t_val > q3 + 4 * iqr or t_val < q1 - 4 * iqr: sev = 'high'
                else:                                                  sev = 'medium'
                anomalies.append({
                    'column': 'repair_hours', 'row_index': int(idx), 'value': raw_val,
                    'expected_range': exp_range, 'severity': sev,
                    'explanation': f"repair_hours value {raw_val} lies outside expected range {exp_range}."
                })
                cap -= 1

    result['anomalies'] = anomalies
except Exception:
    pass

result['assumptions'] = [
    "Cancelled work orders (row_kind='cancel' or STATUS in cancelled list) excluded from all KPIs.",
    "repair_hours column used as-is; rows with repair_hours < 0 excluded from MTTR.",
    "MTTR computed only for CM/EM work types: total repair_hours / distinct WOs.",
    "PM share = distinct PM WOs / all distinct non-cancelled WOs.",
    "Anomaly detection uses log1p transform when |skew| > 2; columns flagging >5% rows treated as heavy-tailed."
]

anomaly_alerts.description: Read as manufacturing data (MTTR, corrective work orders, open work orders, preventive share of work orders, assets). Ratios pool their parts (OEE and availability over planned production time, summed over shifts and machines before dividing), so a line's figure pools its machines' time; MTBF is run time per failure and assumes a constant failure rate; MTTR runs from actual start to actual finish of finished repairs, so repairs still open are not in it and it can read low. Readings are averaged, not time-weighted. Times are read in the zone they are written in (a file mixing offsets is read in UTC). Oct 2026 is partial (data through the 24th) and is left out of period comparisons. 39 cancelled work orders are left out of every count and of MTTR. The data covers 5 months, so month-over-month changes may be seasonal; there is no same month last year to compare with. Reporters are people: figures by who reported a work order describe the work, never rank the people, and groups of fewer than 11 people are not shown.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Filter cancelled rows
cancelled_statuses = ['can', 'cancel', 'cancelled', 'canceled', 'void', 'voided', 'rejected']
df_active = df[~df['row_kind'].isin(['cancel'])].copy()
df_active = df_active[~df_active['STATUS'].str.lower().isin(cancelled_statuses)].copy()

# Derive repair_hours if not present (use existing if available)
if 'repair_hours' not in df_active.columns:
    df_active['repair_hours'] = (pd.to_datetime(df_active['ACTFINISH'], utc=True) - pd.to_datetime(df_active['ACTSTART'], utc=True)).dt.total_seconds() / 3600

# Parse dates
for col in ['REPORTDATE', 'ACTSTART', 'ACTFINISH']:
    df_active[col] = pd.to_datetime(df_active[col], utc=True, errors='coerce')

# Compute response_hours (ACTSTART - REPORTDATE) and duration_hours (repair_hours)
df_active['response_hours'] = (df_active['ACTSTART'] - df_active['REPORTDATE']).dt.total_seconds() / 3600
df_active['duration_hours'] = df_active['repair_hours'].copy()

numeric_cols = ['response_hours', 'duration_hours']

# EDA
try:
    eda = {}
    for col in numeric_cols:
        s = df_active[col].dropna()
        if len(s) > 0:
            eda[col] = {
                "mean": float(s.mean()),
                "std": float(s.std()),
                "min": float(s.min()),
                "max": float(s.max()),
                "median": float(s.median()),
                "count": int(s.count())
            }
    result['eda_summary'] = eda
except Exception:
    pass

# Segmentation
try:
    seg_results = []
    seg_cols = ['WORKTYPE', 'STATUS', 'FAILURECODE']
    metric_cols = ['duration_hours', 'response_hours']

    for seg in seg_cols:
        for met in metric_cols:
            grp = df_active.groupby(seg)[met].mean().dropna()
            top = grp.nlargest(10)
            seg_results.append({
                "segment_column": seg,
                "metric_column": met,
                "aggregation": "mean",
                "label": None,
                "results": [{"name": str(k), "value": round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in top.items()]
            })

    # Count of work orders per segment
    for seg in seg_cols:
        grp = df_active.groupby(seg)['WONUM'].nunique().nlargest(10)
        seg_results.append({
            "segment_column": seg,
            "metric_column": "WONUM",
            "aggregation": "count",
            "label": None,
            "results": [{"name": str(k), "value": float(v)} for k, v in grp.items()]
        })

    # PM share overall
    pm_types = ['pm', 'preventive', 'preventive maintenance', 'planned', 'planned maintenance',
                'pdm', 'predictive', 'predictive maintenance', 'condition based', 'cbm',
                'inspection', 'routine', 'calibration']
    total_wos = df_active['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_wos = df_active[df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().isin(pm_types)]['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_share = pm_wos / total_wos if total_wos > 0 else 0.0
    seg_results.append({
        "segment_column": "WORKTYPE",
        "metric_column": "WONUM",
        "aggregation": "ratio",
        "label": "pm_share",
        "results": [{"name": "pm", "value": round(float(pm_share), 4)},
                    {"name": "non_pm", "value": round(float(1 - pm_share), 4)}]
    })

    # MTTR by FAILURECODE
    cm_types = ['cm', 'em', 'corrective', 'corrective maintenance', 'emergency',
                'emergency maintenance', 'emergency repair', 'breakdown', 'breakdown maintenance',
                'breakdown repair', 'reactive', 'reactive maintenance', 'unplanned',
                'unplanned maintenance', 'unplanned breakdown', 'repair', 'fault', 'failure']
    df_cm = df_active[df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().isin(cm_types) & (df_active['duration_hours'] >= 0)]
    if len(df_cm) > 0:
        mttr_by_fc = df_cm.groupby('FAILURECODE').apply(
            lambda x: x['duration_hours'].sum() / x['WONUM'].nunique()
        ).nlargest(10)
        seg_results.append({
            "segment_column": "FAILURECODE",
            "metric_column": "duration_hours",
            "aggregation": "ratio",
            "label": "mttr_hours",
            "results": [{"name": str(k), "value": round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in mttr_by_fc.items()]
        })

    result['segments'] = seg_results
except Exception:
    pass

# Trends - MoM on response_hours and duration_hours by WORKTYPE
try:
    df_active['month'] = df_active['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')
    trends = []

# --- SEGMENTATION ---

    wt_lower = df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().str.strip()

    # WO count by WORKTYPE

    # WO count by STATUS

    segs.append({"segment_column": "STATUS", "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "count",

    # WO count by FAILURECODE (top 10)

    fc_counts.columns = ['name', 'value']

                 "label": "wo_count_by_failurecode",

    # PM share overall
    total_wos = df_active['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_mask = wt_lower.isin(pm_types)
    pm_wos = df_active[pm_mask]['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_share = pm_wos / total_wos if total_wos > 0 else 0.0
    segs.append({"segment_column": "WORKTYPE", "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "ratio",
                 "label": "pm_share",

    # MTTR by FAILURECODE (top 10 by mean repair_hours)

        if len(cm_df) > 0:
            mttr_fc = cm_df.groupby('FAILURECODE').apply(

            ).nlargest(10).reset_index()

            segs.append({"segment_column": "FAILURECODE", "metric_column": repair_col, "aggregation": "ratio",

        open_asset.columns = ['name', 'value']
        segs.append({"segment_column": "ASSETNUM", "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "count",
                     "label": "open_wos_by_asset",

    result['segments'] = segs
except Exception:
    pass

    anomalies = []
    if repair_col and repair_col in df_active.columns:
        col = repair_col
        s = df_active[col].dropna()
        skew = float(s.skew())
        if abs(skew) > 2:
            shift = max(0, -s.min())
            s_t = np.log1p(s + shift)
        else:
            s_t = s.copy()
            shift = 0
        q1, q3 = s_t.quantile(0.25), s_t.quantile(0.75)
        iqr = q3 - q1
        lo_t, hi_t = q1 - 3 * iqr, q3 + 3 * iqr
        flagged = df_active[(s_t < lo_t) | (s_t > hi_t)][col]
        pct_flagged = len(flagged) / len(s) if len(s) > 0 else 0
        if abs(skew) > 2:
            lo_orig = float(np.expm1(lo_t) - shift)
            hi_orig = float(np.expm1(hi_t) - shift)
        else:
            lo_orig, hi_orig = float(lo_t), float(hi_t)
        exp_range = f"{lo_orig:.2f} to {hi_orig:.2f}"
        if pct_flagged > 0.05:
            anomalies.append({"column": col, "row_index": None, "value": None,
                               "expected_range": exp_range, "severity": "low",
                               "explanation": f"{col} is heavy-tailed; extreme boundary is {exp_range}"})
        else:
            extreme_lo = q1 - 5 * iqr
            extreme_hi = q3 + 5 * iqr
            hi4 = q3 + 4 * iqr
            for idx in flagged.index[:25]:
                raw_val = float(df_active.loc[idx, col])
                if abs(skew) > 2:
                    t_val = np.log1p(raw_val + shift)
                else:
                    t_val = raw_val
                if t_val > extreme_hi or t_val < extreme_lo:
                    sev = "critical"
                elif t_val > hi4 or t_val < (q1 - 4 * iqr):
                    sev = "high"
                else:
                    sev = "medium"
                anomalies.append({"column": col, "row_index": int(idx), "value": raw_val,
                                   "expected_range": exp_range, "severity": sev,
                                   "explanation": f"{col} value {raw_val} lies outside expected range {exp_range}"})
    result['anomalies'] = anomalies[:25]
except Exception:
    pass

result['assumptions'] = [

    "PM share = distinct PM WOs / all distinct WOs (non-cancelled).",
    "Anomaly detection skips columns with >50% missing or <5 unique values."
]

    mttr_val     = (df_corr['repair_hours'].sum() / corr_wos) if corr_wos > 0 else 0.0

    segs.append({'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE', 'metric_column': 'WONUM', 'aggregation': 'ratio',
                 'label': 'pm_share',
                 'results': [{'name': 'pm',     'value': round(pm_share_val, 4)},
                             {'name': 'non_pm', 'value': round(1 - pm_share_val, 4)}]})

    # WO count by WORKTYPE
    wt_cnt = df_active.groupby('WORKTYPE')['WONUM'].nunique().nlargest(10)
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE', 'metric_column': 'WONUM', 'aggregation': 'count',
                 'label': None,
                 'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': float(v)} for k, v in wt_cnt.items()]})

    # Mean repair_hours by WORKTYPE
    wt_rh = df_active.groupby('WORKTYPE')['repair_hours'].mean().dropna().nlargest(10)
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE', 'metric_column': 'repair_hours', 'aggregation': 'mean',
                 'label': None,
                 'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in wt_rh.items()]})

    # WO count by STATUS
    st_cnt = df_active.groupby('STATUS')['WONUM'].nunique().nlargest(10)
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'STATUS', 'metric_column': 'WONUM', 'aggregation': 'count',
                 'label': None,
                 'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': float(v)} for k, v in st_cnt.items()]})

    # Mean repair_hours by STATUS
    st_rh = df_active.groupby('STATUS')['repair_hours'].mean().dropna().nlargest(10)
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'STATUS', 'metric_column': 'repair_hours', 'aggregation': 'mean',
                 'label': None,
                 'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in st_rh.items()]})

    # WO count by FAILURECODE (top 10)
    fc_cnt = df_active.groupby('FAILURECODE')['WONUM'].nunique().nlargest(10)
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'FAILURECODE', 'metric_column': 'WONUM', 'aggregation': 'count',
                 'label': None,
                 'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': float(v)} for k, v in fc_cnt.items()]})

    # MTTR by FAILURECODE (corrective only, top 10 by mttr)
    if len(df_corr) > 0:
        mttr_fc = (df_corr.groupby('FAILURECODE')['repair_hours'].sum() /
                   df_corr.groupby('FAILURECODE')['WONUM'].nunique()).dropna().nlargest(10)
        segs.append({'segment_column': 'FAILURECODE', 'metric_column': 'repair_hours',
                     'aggregation': 'mean', 'label': 'mttr_by_failurecode',
                     'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in mttr_fc.items()]})

    # WO count by ASSETNUM (top 10)
    asset_cnt = df_active.groupby('ASSETNUM')['WONUM'].nunique().nlargest(10)
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'ASSETNUM', 'metric_column': 'WONUM', 'aggregation': 'count',
                 'label': None,
                 'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': float(v)} for k, v in asset_cnt.items()]})

    result['segments'] = segs
except Exception:
    pass

# ── TRENDS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try:
    df_active['report_month'] = df_active['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')

    # MoM WO count overall
    mo_wos = df_active.groupby('report_month')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_index()
    if len(mo_wos) >= 2:
        v = mo_wos.values.astype(float)
        fh, sh = v[:len(v)//2].mean(), v[len(v)//2:].mean()
        pct = float((sh - fh) / fh * 100) if fh != 0 else 0.0
        result['trends'].append({'column': 'WONUM', 'period': 'MoM',
                                 'direction': 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat'),
                                 'pct_change': round(pct, 2), 'segment': None})

    # MoM mean repair_hours overall
    mo_rh = df_active.groupby('report_month')['repair_hours'].mean().sort_index()
    if len(mo_rh) >= 2:
        v = mo_rh.values.astype(float)
        fh, sh = v[:len(v)//2].mean(), v[len(v)//2:].mean()
        pct = float((sh - fh) / fh * 100) if fh != 0 else 0.0
        result['trends'].append({'column': 'repair_hours', 'period': 'MoM',
                                 'direction': 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat'),
                                 'pct_change': round(pct, 2), 'segment': None})

    # MoM WO count per WORKTYPE
    for wt, grp in df_active.groupby('WORKTYPE'):
        mo = grp.groupby('report_month')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_index()
        if len(mo) >= 2:
            v = mo.values.astype(float)
            fh, sh = v[:len(v)//2].mean(), v[len(v)//2:].mean()
            pct = float((sh - fh) / fh * 100) if fh != 0 else 0.0
            result['trends'].append({'column': 'WONUM', 'period': 'MoM',
                                     'direction': 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat'),
                                     'pct_change': round(pct, 2), 'segment': str(wt)})
except Exception:
    pass

# ── ANOMALIES ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try:
    anomalies = []
    col = 'repair_hours'
    rh_s = df_active[col].dropna()
    rh_s = rh_s[rh_s >= 0]
    skew = float(rh_s.skew())
    shift = max(0.0, -float(rh_s.min()))
    if abs(skew) > 2:
        transformed = np.log1p(rh_s + shift)
    else:
        transformed = rh_s.copy()
    q1 = float(transformed.quantile(0.25))
    q3 = float(transformed.quantile(0.75))
    iqr = q3 - q1
    lo3, hi3 = q1 - 3 * iqr, q3 + 3 * iqr
    flagged = transformed[(transformed < lo3) | (transformed > hi3)]
    flag_pct = len(flagged) / len(transformed) if len(transformed) > 0 else 0.0
    if abs(skew) > 2:
        lo_orig = float(np.expm1(lo3) - shift)
        hi_orig = float(np.expm1(hi3) - shift)
    else:
        lo_orig, hi_orig = float(lo3), float(hi3)
    exp_range = f'{lo_orig:.2f} to {hi_orig:.2f} hours'
    if flag_pct > 0.05:
        anomalies.append({'column': col, 'row_index': None, 'value': None,
                          'expected_range': exp_range, 'severity': 'low',
                          'explanation': f'Column {col} is heavy-tailed; anomaly flagging skipped.'})
    else:
        for idx in list(flagged.index)[:25]:
            raw_val = float(rh_s.loc[idx])
            t_val   = float(transformed.loc[idx])
            if   t_val > q3 + 5 * iqr or t_val < q1 - 5 * iqr: sev = 'critical'
            elif t_val > q3 + 4 * iqr or t_val < q1 - 4 * iqr: sev = 'high'
            else:                                                  sev = 'medium'
            anomalies.append({'column': col, 'row_index': int(idx), 'value': raw_val,
                               'expected_range': exp_range, 'severity': sev,
                               'explanation': f'repair_hours value {raw_val:.2f} lies outside expected range {exp_range}.'})
    result['anomalies'] = anomalies[:25]
except Exception:
    pass

result['assumptions'] = [
    'Cancelled work orders (row_kind cancel/void/rejected) excluded from all KPIs.',

findings.text: Work orders split into 290 preventive (PM), 255 corrective (CM), and 56 emergency (EM) orders; emergency orders fell 19.4% month-over-month from August to September 2026 while corrective orders were essentially flat at +0.8%.
Emergency work orders average 5.96 repair hours, corrective orders average 3.52 hours, and preventive orders average 2.13 hours, with individual repair times ranging from 0 to 19.92 hours.

Among the 333 work orders carrying a Failure Code, SEAL is the most frequent at 79 orders, followed by BELT at 63, SENSOR at 58, MOTOR at 56, and BEARING at 55; SENSOR failures average the longest repair time at 4.45 hours.
Of 640 work orders, 353 are completed (COMP), 208 are closed (CLOSE), and 40 remain open (20 in progress, 20 awaiting approval); 39 cancelled orders are excluded from all counts.
Average repair hours: EM (5.96) is higher than PM (2.13).
Mttr by failurecode: SENSOR (4.45) is higher than MOTOR (3.68).

expert_review.review_summary: 12 claims checked against the evidence; 1 flagged (1 contradicted).
gaps: The report does not break down work order volume or repair hours by Asset Number beyond the top 10 assets shown. A complete asset-level analysis would help identify whether the 3 assets not in the top 10 have significantly different maintenance profiles.

No analysis of work order trends by Failure Code over time. Since SEAL, BELT, and SENSOR failures dominate, tracking whether their frequency or repair times are changing month-over-month could reveal emerging reliability patterns.

The report does not examine the relationship between Work Type and Failure Code. Understanding which failure codes are most common in corrective versus emergency work could inform preventive maintenance strategy.
next_investigations: Compare the status distribution (COMP, CLOSE, INPRG, WAPPR) by Work Type to determine whether emergency or corrective work orders are more likely to remain open.
methodology_concerns: MTTR of 3.97 hours excludes the 40 open work orders and 39 cancelled orders. The report acknowledges open orders are excluded, but does not quantify how many open EM or CM orders exist, which could materially affect the true average repair time if resolved.

Repair hours are right-skewed (range 0 to 19.92, median 2.54 vs. mean 3.08), and the evidence notes an IQR anomaly transform was applied. The report presents means without noting this skew, which may overstate typical repair duration.

Month-over-month comparisons use only August and September 2026 (October is partial and excluded). The data covers only 5 months total, so seasonal patterns cannot be ruled out and trends may not persist.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Filter cancelled rows using row_kind
df_active = df[~df['row_kind'].isin(['cancel', 'cancelled', 'canceled', 'void', 'voided', 'rejected'])].copy()

# Parse dates
for col in ['REPORTDATE', 'ACTSTART', 'ACTFINISH']:
    df_active[col] = pd.to_datetime(df_active[col], utc=True, errors='coerce')

# Compute repair_hours if not present (use existing if available)
if 'repair_hours' not in df_active.columns:
    df_active['repair_hours'] = (df_active['ACTFINISH'] - df_active['ACTSTART']).dt.total_seconds() / 3600.0

# Corrective WO filter
corrective_types = ['cm','em','corrective','corrective maintenance','emergency','emergency maintenance',
                    'emergency repair','breakdown','breakdown maintenance','breakdown repair','reactive',
                    'reactive maintenance','unplanned','unplanned maintenance','unplanned breakdown',
                    'repair','fault','failure']
df_corr = df_active[df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().isin(corrective_types) & (df_active['repair_hours'] >= 0)]

# PM filter
pm_types = ['pm','preventive','preventive maintenance','planned','planned maintenance','pdm','predictive',
            'predictive maintenance','condition based','cbm','inspection','routine','calibration']
df_pm = df_active[df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().isin(pm_types)]

# Open WO filter
open_statuses = ['inprg','in progress','wappr','waiting on approval','appr','approved','wmatl',
                 'waiting on material','wsched','waiting to be scheduled','open','hold']
df_open = df_active[df_active['STATUS'].str.lower().isin(open_statuses)]

# --- EDA ---
try:
    rh = df_active['repair_hours'].dropna()
    rh_valid = rh[rh >= 0]
    result['eda_summary']['repair_hours'] = {
        'mean': float(rh_valid.mean()),
        'std': float(rh_valid.std()),
        'min': float(rh_valid.min()),
        'max': float(rh_valid.max()),
        'median': float(rh_valid.median()),
        'count': int(rh_valid.count())
    }
    total_wos = df_active['WONUM'].nunique()
    corrective_wos = df_corr['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_wos = df_pm['WONUM'].nunique()
    open_wos = df_open['WONUM'].nunique()
    assets = df_active['ASSETNUM'].nunique()
    pm_share = pm_wos / total_wos if total_wos > 0 else 0.0
    mttr = df_corr['repair_hours'].sum() / corrective_wos if corrective_wos > 0 else 0.0
    result['eda_summary']['total_work_orders'] = {'mean': float(total_wos), 'std': 0.0, 'min': float(total_wos), 'max': float(total_wos), 'median': float(total_wos), 'count': int(total_wos)}
    result['eda_summary']['corrective_wos'] = {'mean': float(corrective_wos), 'std': 0.0, 'min': float(corrective_wos), 'max': float(corrective_wos), 'median': float(corrective_wos), 'count': int(corrective_wos)}
